rdfs:label: instructionalMethod
rdfs:comment: A process used to engender knowledge, attitudes, and skills that the resource is designed to support — e.g. lecture, problem-based learning, workshop.
notes: Used in educational-resources metadata to describe the teaching method (lecture, problem-set, workshop, MOOC video). Upstream range is `dcterms:MethodOfInstruction`: an IRI from a controlled vocabulary is preferred; a free-form string is a fallback. Pair with `urn:solid:educationLevel`. For the educational audience use `dcterms:audience` (not `urn:solid:audience`, which is ActivityStreams addressing).

history.note: Comment aligned with upstream; seeAlso dcterms:audience instead of urn:solid:audience; notes prefer controlled-vocabulary IRIs.
